er_v06_c11_b001_01: If today's batch sells, it should be enough.
er_v06_c11_b001_02: Price the goods first. Don't start from the number you want.
er_v06_c11_b001_03: I know, I know. I can already say that line for you.
er_v06_c11_b001_04: I know exactly how much is missing. If it's not enough, I'll make another run to the dump tomorrow.
er_v06_c11_b002_01: There. I think the money should be enough.
er_v06_c11_b002_03: I've counted it three times! Eight hundred. Not a credit short.
er_v06_c11_b002_04: Before, a number like that was just a line on a bill. I'd skim past it without even looking.
er_v06_c11_b002_05: Now I can tell you where every single credit came from.
er_v06_c11_b002_06: Including the scrap you spent ages wiping?
er_v06_c11_b002_07: The material from that later sold too. Stop calling it scrap.
er_v06_c11_b002_08: The investigator agreed to start with my mother's work records, not go straight to the company.
er_v06_c11_b002_09: Don't hand him all the originals.
er_v06_c11_b002_10: I kept copies, and I wrote down every meeting time.
er_v06_c11_b002_13: Thank you. I'm going to find out who did this to my mother.
er_v06_c11_b002_14: ...Today I was going to say I finally don't have to keep running to your shop.
er_v06_c11_b002_16: I didn't say that. Until it's cleared up, I still have to eat.
er_v06_c11_b003_01: I can pay. But from now on, you listen to me.
er_v06_c11_b003_02: Put the business terms in writing. Whether I take the loan is my decision.
er_v06_c11_b003_05: My mother never taught me to pay my debts with myself. That's not how things work down here either.
er_v06_c11_b004_01: The money's done. I sold the rest of the goods to another buyer and took an advance on some short work.
er_v06_c11_b004_03: Not great. I'll be working extra days. But I'll manage.
er_v06_c11_b004_04: Don't look at me like that. I said I'd find a way.
er_v06_c11_b005_01: The last part of the shortfall, I was planning to cover with the locket.
er_v06_c11_b005_02: It's been hanging on me doing nothing. Now I want it to help me find my mother.
er_v06_c11_b005_04: I have. Price it like anything else.
er_v06_c12_b001_02: First tell me: was he followed?
er_v06_c12_b001_03: He says no. We changed the handoff point, and I didn't come straight here.
er_v06_c12_b001_04: It's a data drive, hidden in my mother's old lab at the hydroponics farm.
er_v06_c12_b001_06: It has a password. He couldn't. But I know it. Mom always used my birthday.
er_v06_c12_b001_07: I told her so many times that it wasn't safe. She said she was afraid she'd forget it one day when she was busy.
er_v06_c12_b001_10: I can't wait any longer. Let's open it here.
er_v06_c12_b002_02: This is... genetic research. About nutrifruit.
er_v06_c12_b002_03: She found a way to make ordinary nutrifruit produce seeds again.
er_v06_c12_b002_04: Plant it once, and you can keep your own seed.
er_v06_c12_b002_05: Yes. With this data, any decent biohacker could modify it.
er_v06_c12_b002_06: No one would have to buy seeds from Pastel again. It would cost Pastel a fortune.
er_v06_c12_b002_07: That's why they went after her.
er_v06_c12_b002_08: There are work records too. She wrote that someone demanded she stop the experiment. Not long after, her access was revoked.
er_v06_c12_b002_09: The embezzlement charge was fabricated. All of it. The representative of Pastel's station office planned the whole thing.
er_v06_c12_b002_10: That alone won't make a court release her.
er_v06_c12_b002_11: I know. But at least now I know what she was doing, and what they were afraid of.
er_v06_c12_b002_12: Don't rush to take it out.
er_v06_c12_b002_13: I know. My mother is still in their hands.
er_v06_c12_b002_14: I... I need some time to think about what to do.
er_v06_c12_b003_01: Leave it with me. No one takes it without asking you first.
er_v06_c12_b003_02: You know this isn't ordinary stored goods?
er_v06_c12_b003_03: I know. That's why I'm telling you first.
er_v06_c12_b004_01: People come and go here every day. It'll be safer with you.
er_v06_c12_b004_02: All right. We agree on who it goes to first. No changing our minds at the last minute.
er_v06_c12_b005_01: This is too big. I can't be involved anymore.
er_v06_c12_b005_02: ...I understand. I'll take the drive. Please don't tell anyone what I said today.
er_v06_c13_b002_02: Someone handled the paperwork. See? Some things aren't as hard as you think.
er_v06_c13_b003_01: Boss. I'm here to pass on a message. About Eleanor, and the thing she's carrying.
er_v06_c13_b004_01: We know you've been dealing with Eleanor. We also know about the drive.
er_v06_c13_b004_02: Who are you passing the message for?
er_v06_c13_b004_03: She's seen what's on it. She knows who.
er_v06_c13_b004_04: Tell her to give it back, or her mother dies.
er_v06_c13_b004_05: If she hands it over, we release her mother. She'll be exiled to the lower levels, but she'll live.
er_v06_c13_b004_07: It doesn't matter whether you believe me. She just has to.
er_v06_c13_b004_08: If you get her to return it, you'll earn three hundred credits.
er_v06_c13_b004_09: You run a pawnshop. Why make this complicated?
er_v06_c13_b004_10: Who handles the release? When can she see her mother?
er_v06_c13_b004_11: Someone will handle it. Not your concern.
er_v06_c13_b004_12: You really plan to see this through for her? ...Don't take too long.
er_v06_c13_b005_01: Boss, you'd better think carefully. Your name will be in the record too.
er_v06_c13_b005_02: Then write it all down. Don't just write hers.
er_v06_c13_b006_01: Message delivered. Tell her to come talk when she's decided.
er_v06_c14_b001_01: *tells her about their offer to release her mother*
er_v06_c14_b001_02: If I return the drive, they'll let her go?
er_v06_c14_b001_04: He also said I'd get three hundred when it's done.
er_v06_c14_b001_06: You should know all of it.
er_v06_c14_b001_08: But if I publish it, they'll kill her. And then no one would need Pastel's seeds anymore.
er_v06_c14_b001_09: I want her to live. I can't pretend to be brave about that.
er_v06_c14_b001_11: But the research is real. You saw it.
er_v06_c14_b001_12: Even if I secretly keep a copy and hand it back, they'd still find a way to hurt her.
er_v06_c14_b001_13: So if we want to keep the research, we have to make sure they can't reach her first.
er_v06_c14_b001_14: I don't know what to do. If it were you, what would you do?
er_v06_c14_b002_01: There's a way. Apply to have her moved into supervised protective custody, then reopen the review of her case.
er_v06_c14_b002_02: The frame-up and the threat records prove she's in danger now. The research explains why they're doing this.
er_v06_c14_b002_03: I'll prepare her identity papers and medical history. I know what medication she used to take.
er_v06_c14_b003_01: I don't have a channel that can get her out. My word alone isn't enough.
er_v06_c14_b003_02: Then we negotiate their release terms first. I can't gamble with my mother's life.
er_v06_c14_b004_01: If someone takes over her protection, I want to know who's responsible and when I can see her.
er_v06_c14_b004_02: Verify what can be verified first. Publishing without protection means gambling with her life.
er_v06_c14_b004_03: And don't go see that enforcer alone.
er_v06_c14_b004_05: I'm already waiting for one person to come out of there. I don't want to wait for another.
er_v06_c14_b005_01: Bring your mother back first. Return the research.
er_v06_c14_b005_02: You're right. She's my only family.
er_v06_c14_b005_03: But I want to see them release her myself. Not send her from one locked door into another.
er_v06_c14_b006_01: Secure the transfer and protection first. Once she's safe, we decide who gets the research.
er_v06_c14_b006_02: All right. I'll organise her records. Tell me what you need, and don't do everything alone and only tell me afterward.
er_v06_c14_b007_01: If we publish, everyone will know what they did. But I can't promise your mother will live.
er_v06_c14_b007_03: Let me think again. I can't hide it just because I'm afraid, and I can't pretend I'm the only one who's afraid.
er_v06_c14_b008_02: This matters more than either of us. Mom would want everyone to have it.
er_v06_c14_b008_04: No. I'm taking it to a lower-level newspaper today.
er_v06_c14_b008_05: But don't tell me that means she'll be safe. We both know it doesn't.
er_v06_c15_b002_01: I submitted her records. I rechecked the medication section again.
er_v06_c15_b002_02: The application is in too. We're waiting for a reply.
er_v06_c15_b002_03: You didn't tell me 'it's already fine.'
er_v06_c15_b002_05: That's better, actually. People used to tell me 'don't worry' every time they saw me, and then I never saw them again.
er_v06_c15_b002_06: Are you still taking short work tonight?
er_v06_c15_b002_07: Yes. Waiting for news doesn't feed anyone.
er_v06_c15_b002_08: I told my roommate that if anyone asks where my mother lives, not to say a word.
er_v06_c15_b002_10: She said I've learned this late.
er_v06_c15_b003_01: Your name is on the application too.
er_v06_c15_b003_03: I checked your shop address twice.
er_v06_c15_b003_05: Afraid that if something happens, I wouldn't be able to find you.
er_v06_c15_b003_07: I know. That's why I dared to take it this far.
er_v06_c15_b004_01: The safety review for the person concerned has been accepted. Transfer to temporary protective custody approved; family may visit after verification. This measure does not mean the original case is dismissed.
er_v06_c15_b004_03: Go to the place and time written there. Verify first, then see her.
er_v06_c15_b004_05: If it's real, I'll come back and tell you. In person.
er_v06_c15_b005_01: They agreed to arrange the release and the handover on the same day.
er_v06_c15_b005_02: Verify the person and the paperwork first. Don't just trust the messenger.
er_v06_c15_b005_03: I want my mother to confirm it herself. Someone else reading a line for her doesn't count.
er_v06_c15_b005_04: What about a copy of the research?
er_v06_c15_b005_05: No copy. If I'm using it to buy her life, I can't gamble on them not finding out.
er_v06_c15_b005_07: I have. If there's another way later, that's for later.
er_v06_c15_b005_08: Today, I just want to see her.
er_v06_c15_b006_01: Still no confirmation that she can be released, right?
er_v06_c15_b006_02: No. We can keep applying, or switch to the exchange.
er_v06_c15_b006_03: I don't want to treat 'processing' as if she's already safe. Get her out first.
